newsitem.title: USA: Lincare Holdings Inc names John Byrnes CEO.
newsitem.headline: Lincare Holdings Inc names John Byrnes CEO.

text.p: Lincare Holdings Inc said Thursday that effective January 1 John Byrnes will become chief executive.
Byrnes will succeed James Kelly in that position, the company said.

Kelly, who has served as Lincare's CEO since 1986, will continue as chairman and will maintain an active role in the areas of strategic planning and development, legislative policy affairs, and relations with the investment community.
Byrnes was appointed a vice president of the company in 1990, when he assumed responsibility for Lincare's western region operations.
